run_cem_optimization: run the Cross-Entropy Method optimizer to find optimal action trajectories for a world model
compute_new_robot_pose: compute a new robot pose given current pose and action in xyz, euler angles, and gripper
compute_pose_difference: compute the difference between two 7-DoF poses as xyz, rotation, and gripper deltas
round_small_tensor_elements: round small elements in a tensor to zero below a given threshold
compute_l1_similarity: compute the mean L1 distance between two tensors along the last dimension
